For optimal care of the  Cherry Tree , provide full sun or partial shade to encourage healthy growth and fruit production. Maintain temperatures between 75-85°F (24-29°C) and moderate humidity, as this tropical tree thrives in warm, humid conditions. Use well-draining soil with a pH of 5.5-7.5, ranging from slightly acidic to neutral. Water regularly, keeping the soil consistently moist but not waterlogged, especially during dry spells. Fertilize every 4-6 weeks during the growing season with a balanced, water-soluble fertilizer like 10-10-10. Prune annually to shape the tree, remove dead or crowded branches, and encourage better air circulation to prevent pests and diseases. With proper care, the  Cherry Tree will reward you with a delightful harvest of sweet-tart cherries.
